_comment: Authoritative stratified dataset partitions for Stage 2 training and the telemetry-engine scorecard across 86 clean sessions (65 Train, 9 Validation, 12 Holdout Test). Both Validation (524 GT shots) and Holdout Test (722 GT shots) are stratified across all 3 sensor mount modes (NONE, WRIST, BAT_HANDLE) and all 7 canonical shot classes (>=34 shots/class in Val, >=48 shots/class in Holdout) without starving Train of any mount x class combination.
